entities.summary: Jorge Humberto Rodríguez-Novelo is a Mexican-born American Catholic prelate who has served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Denver in Colorado since 2016. He has held teaching positions at Catholic universities and institutions in the United States, Italy and Spain.
